overall_summary: Analysis of 47 unique Shorts reveals a stark performance divergence: immersive first-person 'What If You Fell Into...' cosmic/exoplanet survival scenarios and extreme planetary paradoxes consistently outperform all other formats, generating 800-1,050+ views and 20-38 likes per upload. Conversely, psychology trivia ('Brain can create fake memories', 'Songs stuck in your head') and repeatedly recycled re-uploads severely underperform, stalling between 5 and 95 views. Retention and engagement peak when high-stakes sensory simulation is paired with durations between 19 and 21 seconds.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Hazard Simulation ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,028 views, 38 likes) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) hold the highest view velocity and like-to-view ratios (>3.7%).
winning_patterns.action: Adopt the visceral second-person POV ('You step out...', 'Your suit begins to...') focused on extreme cosmic environments and exotic physical phenomena.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing extreme planetary dynamics like 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,027 views, 36 likes) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (980 views, 21 likes) generated the channel's highest view counts.
winning_patterns.action: Maintain short durations (19–21s) that allow fast-paced visual delivery of astronomical anomalies with strong opening curiosity gaps.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' was posted multiple times and flatlined at 5–53 views; 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' stalled at 17 views.
weak_patterns.action: Halt generic psychology micro-facts; they lack visual tension and fail to hold Shorts feed retention without a high-stakes narrative.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' posted three times achieved only 34 to 220 views with near-zero engagement; multiple octopus heart uploads showed stagnant returns.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict uniqueness rules across script production. Never re-cover covered concepts; always explore fresh astronomical or survival entities.

next_video.hook_style: Second-person sensory immersion / high-stakes cosmic survival
